description.fallback: Three days after the battle with Dio, Speedwagon decides to visit Jonathan in the hospital to offer his emotional support, despite having a broken arm himself. He is stopped at the door to Jonathan's room by an unknown woman. Despite his attempts to argue, the woman refuses to let him in; she says Jonathan is not accepting visitors at the time, and her care for him is more than enough.
